heroEyebrow: Published research · product design · AI safety & evaluation
heroTitle: I design the interfaces and engineer the systems that get the most out of AI.
heroBody: I am an AI engineer and published researcher, with experience across product design, AI/ML research, healthcare, ed tech, and AI safety and evaluation. I bring this breadth and a researcher's discipline to building products: I turn what a person needs into a measured goal, design an interface people find easy to use and an automation layer around it, and, most importantly, build the evaluation that shows whether the system works and how well. Working with founders, policy researchers, and cross-functional teams has made me adept at turning an ambiguous problem into interactive software that people can rely on.

modules.title: What the portfolio demonstrates
modules.markdown: The product dossiers explain the interface, system architecture, implemented workflow, evaluation method, and resulting improvement behind each build. The ML studies document two distinct achievements: a peer-reviewed OpenCV method for measuring brain atrophy and a four-class TensorFlow experiment that improved held-out accuracy through probability-level ensembling.
